description.value:
You adopt a feline aspect, granting you physical traits such as the vertical pupils, sharp nails, and elongated canines.

You gain a darkvision range of 60 feet. If you already possess darkvision, add 60 ft to its range.

Additionally, once per turn when you hit a creature with your natural weapons, you can force the target to make a Constitution Saving Throw. On a failure, the target is Lacerated. The DC for this is 8 + your Proficiency + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). The target can repeat the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Creatures who cannot bleed are Immune to this feature.

Once you reach level 10 in this class, any laceration inflicted with your natural weapons deals damage equal to thrice your Proficiency, rather than twice.
